summary: Iteration 78 — Frontend-only e2e testing of the 4 new marketplace features (AI Concierge, Savings Tracker, Join-to-Save Nudge, Price Parity admin) on BOTH web (?design=radiolife overlay) and mobile (Expo web preview). MOBILE 100% GREEN: demo-login → Shop tab, `shop-concierge-banner` visible ✅; account menu `shop-account-button` → `shop-concierge-link` visible ✅; /shop/concierge screen `concierge-root` loads, concierge-input+concierge-send returned a live Gemini proposal in ~5s (concierge-proposal + concierge-total=$4.00 for large Tandoori Chicken pizza w/ Pizza Club) ✅; /shop/my-memberships shows `savings-tracker` + `savings-month` for demo@ ($0.00 this month, 3 perks used all-time — banner correctly rendered because lifetime_count>0) ✅. Screenshot confirms Pizza Club plan renders `mymem-order-row-*` cards for all 4 pizzas. WEB: Cookie login test@ ok. `shop-concierge-banner` on /shop is visible ✅; /shop/concierge page `rl-concierge-page` loads ✅; Savings Tracker `savings-tracker` on /shop/memberships shows `savings-month=$10.47 this month` ✅ (matches spec). Price Parity admin (/admin/price-parity) fully working ✅: `price-parity-root` renders 34 tracked rows, summary `price-parity-flagged-count`=0 initially, `price-parity-toggle-flagged` works both directions, editing input `price-parity-input-menu:mi_biz_demo_grill_0` to 9.99 + Save persisted the direct price, recomputed `price-parity-drift-*` to +180.3% (flagged), and `price-parity-clear-*` cleared it with toast 'Override cleared'. TWO WEB ISSUES OBSERVED (mobile parity confirms they are web-specific): (1) On the web shop home the account menu `[data-testid=shop-account-menu]` did NOT open after `shop-account-button` clicks in this test run (menu.isVisible=false, 0 shop-concierge-link in DOM) — mobile equivalent works. Could be a click-outside interception in the overlay layer or a state race. Direct /shop/concierge navigation works so this is a discoverability regression, not blocking. (2) Web concierge chat did NOT return a proposal within 30s in two attempts (concierge-response never rendered), while mobile using the same backend endpoint returned a full priced proposal in ~5s — suggests a web-only request wiring issue (axios credentials/CORS?) or a stuck loading state. All other web features work end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking shop-account-button did not open [data-testid=shop-account-menu] in automation (menu never rendered; shop-concierge-link, shop-my-memberships-link, etc. all absent from DOM). Mobile equivalent works fine, so parity of the shop-concierge-link entry point is broken on WEB. Reference: /app/frontend/src/design_radiolife/screens/ShopRadioLife.jsx:82-129

On web the concierge-send POST /api/shop/concierge never produced a concierge-response element within 30s in two attempts (no proposal, no error, no concierge-loading either — state stuck). Same backend + same prompt on mobile returned a proposal (total=$4.00) in ~5s. Suspect axios default withCredentials/CORS or a stuck loading state on the web page. Reference: /app/frontend/src/design_radiolife/screens/ConciergeRadioLife.jsx:23-33

parity_issues.issue: Mobile returns proposal in ~5s; web never renders concierge-response within 30s on the same prompt.
parity_issues.expected: Web should render concierge-proposal + concierge-total within a few seconds after concierge-send
parity_issues.actual: No concierge-response element ever appears; UI stuck (no loading indicator either)

parity_issues.flow: Account menu → Order by Chat link
parity_issues.issue: Mobile shows shop-concierge-link in account menu; web menu did not open on click during automation.
parity_issues.expected: Clicking shop-account-button opens shop-account-menu with shop-concierge-link
parity_issues.actual: Menu did not render; shop-concierge-link absent from DOM

action_items: Investigate the web ConciergeRadioLife submit path — verify axios sends the cookie (should be automatic if a global axios.defaults.withCredentials=true is set at app init) and that setLoading/setResp state updates fire. Add a network-level check in the browser devtools: does POST /api/shop/concierge actually leave the tab? Consider adding a visible error toast in the catch so the user sees failures instead of the UI staying blank.

Investigate why shop-account-button click did not open the menu in headless automation (works on mobile). Possibly the overlay .fixed inset-0 z-[90] click-outside layer is racing with the toggle onClick, or a stopPropagation on a parent is swallowing the click. Consider using onPointerDown or onMouseDown instead of onClick on the toggle, or delaying the outside-click listener registration by a tick.

(Copy) Consider whether Savings Tracker should still render on mobile for a user with lifetime_savings_cents=0 but lifetime_count>0 (demo@). Right now demo@ sees '$0.00 this month · $0.00 saved all-time · 3 perks used' — a $0 savings banner may be confusing. Either gate on lifetime_savings_cents>0 as well, or reword when savings is zero.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/design_radiolife/screens/ConciergeRadioLife.jsx:23-33 — the catch handler sets a generic 'concierge is unavailable' message, but on the failing web run neither response nor loading indicator was showing, implying the promise is neither resolving nor rejecting (or setResp is not committing). Add an AbortController with a 20s timeout + explicit setLoading(false) in a finally so the user is never stuck on a blank state.

/app/frontend/src/design_radiolife/screens/ShopRadioLife.jsx:97-99 — the click-outside div `<div className='fixed inset-0 z-[90]' onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)} />` renders in the same render cycle the menu opens. If pointer events fire in the same event loop tick as the toggle, the outside-click closer will immediately close the menu. In tests headless clicks can trigger both. Consider setMenuOpen via a microtask (setTimeout 0) OR mount the outside-click listener via useEffect after menuOpen becomes true.

/app/backend/routes/marketplace_memberships.py::savings — the mobile savings banner rendering for demo@ shows $0/$0/3perks; either the ledger for demo@ has 3 rows with base_value_cents==0 (points-only perks) or the savings calc excludes something. Worth double-checking that saving amount actually aggregates the entitlement-waived cents and not something narrower.

/app/frontend/src/design_radiolife/screens/CheckoutMenuRadioLife.jsx:141-152 — join_nudge rendering is clean and correctly gated on quote.join_nudge. Absence at Fun Pizza for test@ is expected (Pizza Club auto-applies). Could not deterministically trigger the nudge in this run without adding a cart line at a non-owned-membership venue; recommend a fresh account or an item at Ambreens Salon in the next session for full coverage.

success_rate.frontend: mobile 100% (5/5 checks pass); web ~75% (savings tracker + price parity admin + concierge page load + concierge banner all pass; account-menu link + concierge chat submit failing/flaky)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend concierge is verified working (mobile returned $4.00 total on 'large Tandoori Chicken pizza' in ~5s). Only the WEB submit path is flaky/broken. To reproduce the account-menu bug, log in as test@ via /api/auth/login (POST, credentials include), navigate to /shop?design=radiolife, then click [data-testid=shop-account-button] once — the shop-account-menu should appear but did not in automation. For the concierge bug: navigate to /shop/concierge?design=radiolife, fill concierge-input, click concierge-send, observe that NO concierge-response/concierge-loading/concierge-proposal ever appears. Compare against mobile at /shop/concierge which works in ~5s. Join-to-save nudge on both platforms needs a fresh account or a cart at Ambreens Salon (biz_sample_ambreens) with a service the 'Unlimited Blowouts' plan would cover — did not exercise this run (nudge absence at Fun Pizza for test@ is expected/correct).
rca of the issue: Web account menu likely closes immediately due to the outside-click overlay rendering in the same tick as menuOpen becoming true (ShopRadioLife.jsx line 99). Web concierge submit likely axios not sending the auth cookie or the response promise being swallowed — since savings tracker fetch also uses axios and works, most likely a stuck state (setLoading true never turned off) rather than a network problem. Recommend adding a 20s AbortController + finally block that resets loading.
